item.title: cpython: make bundled pip prefer the system CA bundle
item.description:
pip vendors certifi and adds its cacert.pem to the trust store next to the system store. Every venv made with python -m venv gets this pip from ensurepip. Thus a cacert update alone does not remove a distrusted root (for example emSign ECC Root CA - G3) from pip in a venv.

Tested on x86_64-linux with python3 3.14 (same diff on master): in a venv, pip download six with SSL_CERT_FILE set to an unrelated self-signed cert fails, and with the system bundle it works. Before the change both worked, because pip also trusted its vendored bundle.

item.title: openjdk: generate cacerts from cacert for JDK 11+
item.description:
JDK 8 already builds its cacerts from cacert. JDK 11 and later shipped the CA list that comes with the OpenJDK source. That list does not get the cacert updates, for example the removal of distrusted roots.

Generate the keystore with the bootstrap keytool before configure and give it to --with-cacerts-file. The file goes into the java.base jmod, so jlink images such as jre_minimal also use it.

Write a PKCS12 store without a password, like upstream. The JDK opens cacerts without a password, so it cannot read certificates that a password protects.

Closes: https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/issues/210241 Related to: https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/issues/576485 Related to: https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/issues/576543

This reverses 5a53b98248d7 ("openjdk10: Use included cacerts", 2018). That commit gave no reason. Since then the bundled list has gone stale between JDK releases, and the eMudhra distrust shows the cost: the JDK 11+ store still holds emSign ECC Root CA - G3 and AAA Certificate Services.

Tested on x86_64-linux with openjdk21_headless (same diff on master):

  • keytool -list -cacerts opens without a password: PKCS12, 118 entries. Their SHA-256 fingerprints match the 118 server-auth roots of cacert 3.131.1. AAA (email trust only in cacert) and emSign ECC Root CA - G3 are gone.
  • A jlink minimal JRE gets a byte-identical lib/security/cacerts.
  • HTTPS to github.com works with the default store; with JAVAX_NET_SSL_TRUSTSTORE set to a store without the needed root it fails with "PKIX path building failed".
  • openjdk11, openjdk17_headless, openjdk21, openjdk25 and jre_minimal instantiate on staging.

Note: the cacerts format cannot carry the NSS "distrust after" dates, so those are lost, as they already are for JDK 8.

item.title: nushell: eMudhra fixes
item.description:
Two fixes for the eMudhra intermediate compromise:

  • version check used update-informer's default ureq agent, which trusts only the compiled-in webpki-roots. Patch it to use nushell's own TLS config (tls_config), so it uses the system CA store like http get already does.
  • Bump webpki-roots to 1.0.10 (drops emSign ECC Root CA - G3) and rustls-webpki to 0.103.16 (blocks the eight revoked eMudhra intermediate SPKIs) through a Cargo.lock patch.

Both changes are already merged upstream, after the 0.116.1 release: https://github.com/nushell/nushell/pull/19298 (version check uses nushell's own HTTP client and TLS config) and https://github.com/nushell/nushell/pull/19308 (webpki-roots 1.0.10, webpki-root-certs 1.0.10, rustls-webpki 0.103.16). Drop both patches when nushell is updated to a release that contains them.

Tested on x86_64-linux: build with the full cargo test check phase, http get and version check with SSL_CERT_FILE set to an unrelated root fail, and with the system bundle they work.

Related to: https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/issues/576485 Related to: https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/issues/576544
